title: Provenance
description: Where a dataset came from, as a client's data.provenance.to_json() writes it and Provenance.from_json reads it back, so a record one client stores as JSON loads in the other. It holds the facts the saved file's dfo.* keys hold of the same dataset: the sentence, the citation, the fetch time, the question, the ref, the retention of the dataset and of each member, the warnings and each member's citation. Every key named here is required. The record and each member are open: a reader ignores a key it does not name, so a later client can add one without a new format_version, and writes back only the keys it names. A key that changes the meaning of the record comes with a new format_version, which a reader refuses.

format_version.description: The record's format. A reader refuses a version it does not know.

sentence.description: What the data shows, in Search's words, or the members' sentences in order when there are several.

citation.description: How to cite the data, every member's sources together.

fetched_at.description: When the data left the server, the earliest member's time, as an ISO 8601 time with a zone, on a date that exists on the calendar. A client writes it in UTC to the second, as 2026-11-27T09:14:05Z, and null when any member's fetch time is unknown.

question.description: The question the data answers, for a dataset fetched from an answer, else null.

ref.description: The dataset's ref, or null for a dataset that names no version, as a website bundle read from a folder.

pinned.description: Whether every member's version is kept without a time limit: true exactly when every member's pinned is true, and false for a record with no member.

held_until.description: The earliest date any member's version can still be fetched without being pinned, as YYYY-MM-DD on a date that exists, or null when every member is pinned or the server did not say. When every member's pinned is known, it is the earliest held_until of the members that are not pinned, or null when none has one.

warnings.description: The datasets surface's warnings about the members' data.

spec_id.description: The spec the warning concerns, or null when the server names none or the client did not keep it.

members.description: One entry per member of ref, in its order, naming the member as ref does and adding its citation and its retention. Empty when ref is null.

spec_id.description: The member's spec_id: a dataset spec's spec_ id, or a derived member's ops_ id.

content_version.description: The member's exact version: a cv_ id, or a derived member's ocv_ id.

digest.description: The SHA-256 digest of the artifact the member's data came from, the ref member's artifact.digest.

parts.description: The variable text of each answer part the member answers, in query order.

pinned.description: Whether the member's version is kept without a time limit, or null when the client does not know, as for a file saved before clients recorded each member's retention.

held_until.description: The date the member's version can still be fetched without being pinned, as YYYY-MM-DD on a date that exists, or null when the member is pinned, the server did not say, or the client does not know.
